questions.stem: A 28-year-old patient presents with recurring episodes of epigastric pain and discomfort after consuming protein-rich meals. These symptoms are indicative of impaired protein digestion within the stomach. Pepsin, an enzyme responsible for protein breakdown, requires an appropriate pH environment for its effective functioning. What is the optimal pH for the effective functioning of pepsin in the gastric mucosa?
